blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型将动作和相机运动转化为长视展开,使视频成为互动模拟的自然界面. 这种互动需要反应迅速的生成,但连贯的推出必须保留已产生的视觉记忆。 被剪切的视频传播模型通常会将这种上下文保留在不断增长的KV缓存中,因此后期块会逐渐变慢. 为了解决这一瓶颈,我们引入了Velox,一个无训练的注意路由器,用于区域级上下文选择,使用流出几何的frustum slab对应. Velox代表历史区块作为有深度间隔的相机frustum slabs,通过Recency优先多瓦得到流块深度. 对于覆盖范围很广的区域,frustum slab软地将每层模型产生的块重要性相重叠. 未覆盖区域保留模型衍生的路线,没有几何偏差. 固定的符号块颗粒性匹配了FlashAttenty风格的平板执行并减少了随推出长度而增长的注意名词. Frustum slab 的构造与同一H200上的去诺音同步运行. 在48分时,Velox的注意力加速了4.36分秒, 并且取消了2.43分秒。 在完整的158克W Bench导航分出时,它保持在0.15的API无密度LingBot-Fast-Cam平均点以内. 详情请见我们的项目网页https://velox-world.com/velox/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video world models are emerging as a practical interface for interactive simulation. A user specifies an action trajectory or camera motion, and the model rolls the world forward by generating future video frames. This direction builds on rapid progress in video diffusion transformers and large video foundation models ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) . Recent works increasingly target controllable long video worlds rather than isolated short clips ( Alonso et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2024 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2024 ; Sand.ai, 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; HY-World et al., 2026 ) . For these models, context management is a central methodological challenge. Past frames carry the appearance, geometry, and object state that future frames must respect. Without access to the right history, long rollouts drift, forget revisited regions, or re-synthesize the same scene inconsistently.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型正在成为交互式模拟的实际界面。 一个用户指定了动作轨迹或相机运动,模型通过生成未来的视频帧将世界推向前进. 这一方向建立在视频传播变压器和大型视频基模型的快速进展上(Ho等人,2020年;Rombach等人,2022年;Peebles & Xie,2023年;Blatmann等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年b;Yang等人,2024年b;Kong等人,2024年;Wan等人,2025年;Ma等人,2025年). 近期作品越来越针对可控制的长视频世界而非孤立短片(Alonso等人,2024年;Valevski等人,2024年;Bruce等人,2024年;Parker-Holder等人,2024年;Sand.ai,2025年;Gao等人,2026年;HY-World等人,2026年). 对于这些模型来说,环境管理是方法上的一项核心挑战。 过去帧带有外观,几何,对象表示未来帧必须尊重. 没有正确的历史,长期展开漂移,忘记重新审视的地区,或者以不一致的方式重新合成同一场景。

blocks.en: The most direct way to preserve this history is to retain an ever-growing visual context. Chunked or causal video diffusion models let each new chunk attend to historical frame tokens through a KV cache. Dense FlashAttention makes this practical at moderate lengths ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2023 ) , and causal diffusion or self-forcing training makes long rollouts natural ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2025b ) . The cost, however, grows with the number of generated chunks. Later chunks inherit larger context even when the current camera overlaps only a small part of the past scene. As a result, chunk-wise generation becomes progressively slower exactly when long-horizon consistency matters most.
blocks.zh: 保存这一历史的最直接方式是保留一个不断发展的视觉背景. 被扭曲或因果视频传播模型让每个新块通过KV缓存处理历史帧符号. Dense FlashAtting使这种实用性在中等长度(Dao等人,2022年;Dao,2023年),因果传播或自我强制训练使长期推广变得自然(Chen等人,2024a); Huang等人, 2025b ). 然而,成本随着产生的块数的增加而增加。 后来的块会继承更大的上下文,即使目前的相机只重叠过去场景的一小部分. 因此,当长距离一致性最为重要时,分块生成速度就会逐渐放慢。

blocks.en: This motivates context selection rather than naive context accumulation. Frame- and view-memory methods select a smaller set of relevant past observations. Context-as-Memory retrieves historical views by camera field-of-view overlap, and VMem stores surfel-indexed views for consistent revisits ( Yu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ) . AnchorWeave and related works ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) further inject warped renderings from persistent memory through ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023a ) to stabilize camera-controlled generation. These methods show that not all past frames are equally useful, and figure 1 summarizes this progression from dense history to view-level retrieval. Yet frame-level selection remains coarse for transformer attention. It provides the same selected context to all regions in the active chunk, although dynamic scenes often need local temporal continuity and different regions in the same noisy chunk can depend on different parts of the past. Methods that inject warped point renderings into the model input can also require architectural adaptation or fine-tuning, which limits direct reuse of a pretrained video generator.
blocks.zh: 这激发了上下文的选择,而不是天真的上下文积累. 框架-和视图-模拟方法选择一套较小的过去相关观测数据。 背景-as-Memory通过相机视野重叠检索历史观点,VMem存储Surfel索引视图,以进行一致的重访(Yu等人,2025a;Li等人,2025年)。 AnchorWeave及相关作品(肖等人,2025年;吴等人,2025年;王等人,2026年)通过ControlNet(张等人,2023年a)进一步注入来自持久性内存的扭曲渲染,稳定相机控制生成. 这些方法表明,并非所有过去的框架都同样有用,图1总结了从密集历史到视图级检索的这一进展. 然而,对变压器的注意仍很粗糙。 它为活动块中的所有区域提供了相同的特定背景,尽管动态场景往往需要局部时间连续性,而同一噪音块中的不同地区可能取决于过去的不同部分。 在模型输入中注入扭曲点渲染的方法也可能需要建筑改造或微调,这限制了预先训练的视频生成器的直接再利用.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Three context-management paradigms for long-horizon world generation. Dense chunked generation keeps an ever-growing visual context. Frame-memory methods retrieve a small set of past views using camera overlap. Velox routes each current latent region to compact, geometry-relevant history blocks using frustum slab correspondences.
blocks.zh: 图1:长视世界一代的三个背景管理范式. Dense culted generation 保留着不断增长的视觉环境. Frame-memory方法使用相机重叠来获取一小组过去的视图. Velox利用frustum slab通信将当前每个潜在区域通向紧凑,几何相关的历史区块.

blocks.en: Inspired by inverse rendering works ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ; Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) , we observe that regions whose geometry has already been observed should primarily attend to their corresponding past regions. Newly revealed or uncertain regions, in contrast, may require model-derived semantic context and local temporal neighbors. A road block, a facade block, and newly revealed sky in the same noisy chunk should therefore not necessarily attend to the same past views. The question, then, is no longer only which frames to retrieve, but whether long-context video generation can assign each region its own relevant history while preserving local motion continuity and leaving the pretrained generator unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在反向渲染工作的启发下(Kerbl等人,2023年;Mildenhall等人,2021年),我们观察到,已经观测到几何学的区域应当主要关注它们相应的过去区域. 相反,新发现或不确定的区域可能需要模型产生的语义背景和当地时间邻居。 因此,一个路障、一个外表屏蔽、以及在同一吵闹的块中新暴露的天空,不一定能够关注过去同样的观点。 因此,问题不再仅仅是要取回哪一个帧,而是长文本视频生成是否能够在保留局部运动连续性和保留预训生成器不变的同时指定每个区域自己的相关历史.

blocks.en: We consider this question at the token-block level in the block-wise execution model of FlashAttention ( Dao, 2023 ) . Our key insight is that camera frustum slabs with depth intervals can provide region-specific routing signals at the same granularity used by tiled attention. Instead of adding a new conditioning branch or fine-tuning the video generator, Velox summarizes generated history as per-block frustum slabs and uses their overlap to guide which historical KV token blocks each current region should see. For each target chunk, Velox obtains query-side depth through recency-priority multiwarp and scores query and historical blocks by world-space OBB frustum slab overlap. In well-covered regions, this score softly reweights each layer’s model-derived block importance before selection. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. Previous-chunk retention and global-aligned Gilbert neighborhoods preserve local motion continuity without a separate cross-chunk seam table.
blocks.zh: FlashAtthinding(Dao, 2023)中, 我们的关键见解是,具有深度间隔的照相机浮雕板可以提供区域专用的路由信号,与所铺设的注意力所用的颗粒度相同。 Velox不添加新的调节分支或微调视频生成器,而是将生成的历史总结为每个块的frustum slabs,并利用它们的重叠来引导历史 KV 符牌阻挡每个当前区域应该看到的. 对于每个目标块,Velox通过Recency优先级的多瓦和分数查询和历史块通过世界空间OBB frustum slab重叠获得查询侧深度. 在覆盖范围很广的地区,这一评分在选择前轻轻地重估了每层模型衍生的块重要性. 未覆盖区域保留模型衍生的路线,没有几何偏差。 先前的Chunk保留和全局化的Gilbert邻里保护局部运动连续性,没有单独的跨Chunk接合表.

blocks.en: Across 48-chunk timing traces and the 158-case WBench navigation split ( Ying et al., 2026 ) , Velox reduces the growing long-context attention cost while preserving aggregate quality near dense attention. Its advantage grows with the number of generated chunks. At chunk 48, attention latency decreases from approximately 34.2 34.2 ms with dense FlashAttention to 7.8 7.8 ms, a 4.36 × 4.36\times speedup. Denoising time decreases from approximately 7.19 7.19 s to 2.96 2.96 s under the same single-H200 asynchronous setting. Built on LingBot-Fast-Cam ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , Velox remains within 0.15 0.15 points of dense attention on the WBench API-free average and improves the 19-metric overall average from 75.52 75.52 to 75.60 75.60 . These results support the scoped claim that soft frustum slab routing can alleviate the late-chunk attention bottleneck without materially degrading benchmark quality.
blocks.zh: 横跨48个丰满的计时痕迹和158个案例的W Bench导航分裂(Ying等人,2026年),Velox降低了不断增长的长文本关注成本,同时保持了接近密集关注的整体质量. 它的优势随着生成块的数量而增加. 在48块时,注意力的延缓度从密集闪存的大约34.2-34.2米减少到7.87.8米,速度为4.36×4.36\时。 在同一单H200同步环境下,脱氧核糖核酸时间从约7.19°7.19°S降至2.96°S。 Velox建于LingBot-Fast-Cam(Gao等人,2026年)上,在WBench API无线平均线上仍保持在0.150.15的密集关注点范围内,并改善了19度的总平均值,从75.52.75.2升至75.60 75.60.60. 这些结果支持了范围范围大的说法,即软胸板的路由可以减轻迟到的注意力瓶颈,而不会在物质上降低基准质量。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as: • We introduce Velox, a training-free framework that uses frustum slab correspondences to reduce growing KV attention cost in chunked video world models. • We devise a soft geometric fusion rule that uses OBB frustum slab overlap to modulate each layer’s model-derived block importance while preserving an unbiased fallback for uncovered regions. • We implement Velox with global-aligned Gilbert KV storage, an optimized sparse attention kernel, and asynchronous frustum slab construction on the same H200 as denoising, reaching a 4.36 × 4.36\times attention speedup and a 2.43 × 2.43\times denoising speedup at chunk 48.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳为: 我们引入了Velox,这是一个无培训框架,它使用frustum slab通信来降低小块视频世界模型中日益增长的KV关注成本. ——. 我们设计了一个软几何聚变规则,使用OBB frustum slab重叠来调制每层模型衍生的块重要性,同时为未发现的区域保持不偏袒的退缩。 我们用全球对齐的吉尔伯特·KV存储器执行Velox,一个优化的稀疏关注内核,以及一个同步的Frustum slab构造,在与Danoising相同的H200上,达到4.36×4.36的注意力加速和2.43×2.43的Dnoising速度在48块.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video World Models and Spatial Memory
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频世界模型和空间记忆

blocks.en: Video generation has progressed from latent diffusion to scalable diffusion transformers and rectified flow ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , with foundation models supplying strong visual priors ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ) . Long-video methods extend these priors through progressive generation, self-rollout training, and causal chunking ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Henschel et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Sand.ai, 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025a ) , while interactive models target controllable persistent worlds ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2024 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025d ; Che et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2025b ; Decart et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; HY-World et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . These directions make history management central: more context supports consistency but makes dense attention increasingly expensive. Spatial-memory methods address this tension by retrieving views, preserving revisits, or expanding reconstructed worlds ( Yu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2024b ; Yu et al., 2024a ; Engstler et al., 2024 ) . Camera-aware and controllable generation ( Yu et al., 2024c ; YU et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) and streaming reconstruction ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Leroy et al., 2024 ; Cabon et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Keetha et al., 2025 ) further make projectable memory practical. Velox uses this memory to route pretrained attention rather than adding a conditioning pathway or retrained memory module.
blocks.zh: 视频生成从潜在扩散到可伸缩扩散变压器并纠正流(Ho等人,2020年;Rombach等人,2022年;Blatmann等人,2023年;Peebles & Xie,2023年;Esser等人,2024年),基础模型提供强烈的视觉前科(Yang等人,2024年b;Kong等人,2024年;Wan等人,2025年;HaCohen等人,2024年;Ma等人,2025年;Gao等人,2025年;Team等人,2025年). 长视频方法通过渐进生成、自我推出培训和因果分解扩展这些前科(Kim等人,2024年;Jin等人,2024年;Henschel等人,2024年;Xie等人,2024年;Gu等人,2025年;Chen等人,2024年a年;Huang等人,2025年b年;Sand.ai,2025年;Chen等人,2025年a年;Liu等人,2025年a年),而互动模型则针对可控制的持续世界。 (Bruce等人,2024年;Parker-Holder等人,2024年;Alonso等人,2024年;Valevski等人,2024年;Feng等人,2024年;张等人,2025年d;Che等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年a;Yu等人,2025年b;Decart等人,2024年;Gao等人,2026年;HY-World等人,2026年;沈等人,2026年). 这些方向使历史管理成为中心:更多的背景支持一致性,但使密集的关注越来越昂贵. 空间记忆方法通过检索观点、保留重访或扩大重建的世界来解决这种紧张关系(Yu等人,2025a); Li等人,2025年;Shao等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年a;Chen等人,2025年b;Yu等人,2024年b;Yu等人,2024年a;Engstler等人,2024年). 相机感知和控制生成(Yu等人,2024c;YU等人,2025;Bai等人,2025;He等人,2024;He等人,2025;Yang等人,2025c;Ren等人,2025;Yu等人,2026)和流体重建(Wang等人,2024b;Leroy等人,2024;Cabon等人,2025;Yang等人,2025a;Wang等人,2024a;Wang等人,2025a;Wang等人,2025b;Keetha等人,2025)进一步将可投射记忆付诸实施。 Velox使用这个内存来引导预先训练的注意力,而不是添加一个条件路径或重新训练的内存模块.

blocks.en: 2.2 Efficient Attention and Context Routing
blocks.zh: 2.2 高效的注意和背景跟踪

blocks.en: Long-context transformers reduce attention cost through sparsity, locality, compression, state reuse, heavy-hitter selection, and KV eviction ( Kitaev et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Dai et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023b ; Kwon et al., 2023 ; Li & Wang, 2026 ) , while FlashAttention is the dense IO-aware baseline ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2023 ) . Video accelerators additionally exploit spatial, temporal, denoising-step, and feature regularity through adaptive sparsity, caching, and quantized attention ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Xi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Nawaz et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . These approaches usually derive sparsity from position, cached features, or attention statistics, whereas frame-memory methods select views but retain dense attention within them. Velox connects both directions by using projective correspondence as a soft prior for region-specific attention routes, with model-derived fallback and temporal safeguards.
blocks.zh: 长条形变压器通过螺旋、局部、压缩、状态再利用、重重压选择和KV驱逐来降低注意成本(Kitaev等人,2020年;Zaheer等人,2020年;Beltagy等人,2020年;Wang等人,2020年;Dai等人,2019年;Liu等人,2023年;Lee等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2023年;Kwon等人,2023年;Li & Wang,2026年),闪存是密集的IO-aware基线(Dao等人,2022年;Dao,2023年)。 视频加速器进一步利用空间、时间、脱钩步骤,并通过适应性抽筋、剖析和定量注意来突出规律性(Zhang等人,2025c;Xi等人,2025;Yang等人,2025b;Zhang等人,2025b;Xia等人,2025;Ding等人,2025;Zhang等人,2024;Zhang等人,2025a;Liu等人,2024b;Liu等人,2025b;Liu等人,2024a;Guo等人,2024;Nawaz等人,2026;Feng等人,2026)。 这些方法通常从位置、缓存特征或注意力统计中产生垃圾,而帧模型方法则选择视图,但保留了其中的密集注意力。 Velox通过将投影通信作为区域特定关注路径的软前连接双向,并配有模型衍生回落和时间保障.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Overview. Long-horizon generation requires persistent visual history, yet dense KV attention makes every current region process all retained blocks. Velox keeps the pretrained generator and conditioning interface unchanged and modifies only the inference-time visibility relation between current query blocks and historical KV blocks. It represents history as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals, uses their overlap as a soft prior over each layer’s model-derived block importance, and exposes each current region to a compact route. Figure 2 summarizes this training-free pipeline.

blocks.en: The geometric score should guide a route without imposing the same hard block set on every layer. blocks.en: Global-aligned Gilbert neighborhoods. Velox preserves short-range video continuity through a global/window 26-neighbor adjacency over Gilbert blocks. Earlier versions used a repeated chunk-local Gilbert order and a separate cross-chunk seam table. The current implementation instead builds a single global-aligned Gilbert block domain incrementally. It constructs the single-chunk Gilbert curve once, flips chunk-local coordinates according to chunk parity and the base-frame exit quadrant, and thereby matches the full-sequence Gilbert prefix for every generated chunk. blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details

blocks.en: We instantiate Velox on the LingBot-Fast-Cam inference stack ( Gao et al., 2026 ) with a Wan-style video diffusion transformer. The reported configuration uses recency-priority multiwarp Q-depth, world-space OBB frustum slab IoU, grouped fragment aggregation, and global-aligned Gilbert KV storage. We apply fixed soft geometric fusion to well-covered rows at every transformer layer, with τ = 0.1 \tau=0.1 , g ref = 0.2 g_{\mathrm{ref}}=0.2 , λ = 2 \lambda=2 , and η cov = 0.9 \eta_{\mathrm{cov}}=0.9 . Covered rows retain K cov = 80 K_{\mathrm{cov}}=80 blocks. Uncovered rows use the model-derived cumulative-mass route with K unc = 150 K_{\mathrm{unc}}=150 and no route-size floor.
blocks.zh: 我们在LingBot-Fast-Cam推论堆上(Gao et al., 2026年)用万式的视频传播变压器将Velox进行即时处理. 报告的配置采用惯性优先型多瓦Q深度、世界空间的OBB frustum slab IoU、分组片段汇总以及全球对齐的吉尔伯特·KV存储。 我们在每个变压器层采用固定的软几何聚变法,其中τ=0.1\tau=0.1,g ref=0.2 g_{\mathrm{ref}}=0.2,λ=2\lambda=2,η=0.9 \eta_{\mathrm{cov}}=0.9. 覆盖的行保留K cov = 80 K_{\mathrm{cov}}=80块. 未覆盖行使用模型衍生的累积质量路由,其中K unc = 150 K_{\mathrm{unc}}=150,没有路由大小的地板.

blocks.en: The measured sparse path is a native Triton indexed block-sparse attention implementation rather than a dense call with a Python mask. Current queries are reordered once per chunk, KV caches are stored in global-aligned Gilbert order, and the kernel consumes routed block lists with a runtime route-length bound. The previous chunk is always retained within the route budget, while current-chunk local neighbors and reference-frame blocks act as deterministic safeguards. Frustum slab state is prepared asynchronously with a two-chunk freshness lag, so chunk c c normally consumes geometry through chunk c − 2 c-2 . In the reported timing traces, DiT denoising and asynchronous geometry construction run concurrently on one H200.
blocks.zh: 测量到的稀疏路径是原生的Triton指数化块-sparse关注执行,而不是带有Python面具的密集调用. 当前查询每块重排一次, KV 缓存按全局对齐的吉尔伯特顺序存储, 内核会消耗一个运行时的路由长度约束的路由区块列表 。 之前的块总是保留在路由预算之内,而目前充斥的当地邻居和参考框架块则起到决定性的保障作用. Frustum slab状态与两圆形的新鲜度差同步制备,因此c块c通常通过c块−2c-2消耗几何. 在报告的计时痕迹中,DiT调试和同步几何构造同时运行在一台H200上.

blocks.en: We evaluate quality on all 158 cases of the WBench navigation split ( Ying et al., 2026 ) . The three LingBot-based rows use identical generated cases and the Gemini judge for VLM-scored metrics. Published WBench rows use the official Doubao judge, so judge-dependent values should not be compared across these two groups. We therefore include an API-free average that excludes VLM-scored setting metrics and is comparable across judge backends.
blocks.zh: 我们评价所有158例WBench导航分裂案的质量(Ying等人,2026年)。 基于LingBot的三行使用相同的生成案件和双子座法官对VLM分数的测量. 出版的W Bench rains使用官方的杜宝法官,因此在这两个组别中不应比较法官依赖的价值观. 因此,我们列入了一个无API的平均数,该平均数不包括VLM计分的设定指标,并可在法官的后端进行比较。

blocks.en: 4.2 Attention Scaling over 48 Chunks
blocks.zh: 4.2 超过48块的注意力

blocks.en: Figure 3 reports 48-chunk timing traces. Dense FlashAttention grows with the retained context, while Velox remains nearly flat because each query block receives a bounded route. At chunk 48, per-call attention latency decreases from approximately 34.2 34.2 ms to 7.8 7.8 ms, corresponding to a 4.36 × 4.36\times speedup. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present Velox, a training-free router that projects spatial memory into the current latent camera view and uses frustum slab overlap to modulate layer-specific block importance while retaining model-derived fallback and local temporal safeguards. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by 4.36 × 4.36\times and denoising by 2.43 × 2.43\times with asynchronous geometry construction on one H200. Across all 158 WBench navigation cases, it remains within 0.15 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam and slightly improves the 19-metric overall average. These results show that region-level spatial correspondence can turn persistent world memory into a practical routing signal for long-horizon generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Velox,这是一个无训练的路由器,它将空间内存投射到目前的潜在相机视图中,并使用frustum slab重叠到调制层特异性块重要性,同时保留模型产生的回落和局部时间保障。 在48块时,Velox加速了4.36×4.36\时间,并在1个H200上以同步几何构造调试2.43×2.43\时间. 在所有158个W Bench导航箱中,它保持在0.15 0.15的无API密度LingBot-Fast-Cam平均点以内,并略微改善了19度总平均值。 这些结果表明,区域一级的空间对应可以将持久的世界记忆转化为长视距生成的实用的路由信号.

blocks.en: The current noisy chunk does not provide a reconstructed depth map, yet each query block needs a target-camera depth interval for geometric matching. blocks.en: B.4 Runtime Path and Timing Scope
blocks.zh: B.4 运行时间路径和时间范围

blocks.en: The measured sparse path is a Triton indexed block-sparse attention implementation, not a Python masking wrapper around dense attention. Queries are reordered once per chunk into the global-aligned Gilbert token order, and KV caches are written directly in that layout so that the hot kernel loads contiguous KV tiles without a per-call host permutation. The kernel supports rectangular current-query versus growing-history attention, consumes the routed block lists produced by the fused-score scheduler, and uses a runtime route-length bound so later chunks do not trigger new compiler specializations. Section D gives the full kernel path.
blocks.zh: 测量到的稀疏路径是Triton指数化的块-sparse 注意执行,而不是Python 面具包装器围绕密集的注意. 查询每块重排一次,进入全局对齐的吉尔伯特令牌顺序,KV缓存直接写在这个布局中,这样热的内核加载相邻的KV瓦片,而无需每调用主机穿插. 内核支持长方形电流-query相对于增长-历史关注,消耗了由引信-计分调度器生产的路由区块列表,并使用运行时的路由长度绑定,因此以后的块不会触发新的编译器专业. D节给出了完整的内核路径.

blocks.en: Frustum slab geometry is built asynchronously. After a chunk is decoded, a worker thread on a dedicated CUDA stream updates reconstruction state, records chunk cameras, builds stored frustum slabs, refreshes multiwarp frame caches, and prepares the Velox state for a later chunk while the main stream continues DiT denoising. The implementation uses a two-chunk freshness lag. Chunk c c normally consumes geometry through chunk c − 2 c-2 , which is sufficient because frustum slab overlap changes gradually. The worker is the sole writer to the geometry objects. The main stream waits only on a completion event when a future state is needed. Section C gives the full implementation path, including the worker stream, VAE side stream, prewarming, and tail handling.
blocks.zh: Frustum slab几何是同步建造的. 在一块块解码后,一个专用的CUDA流上的工人线程更新重建状态,记录块状相机,构建存储的frustum slabs,刷新多warp帧缓存,并在主流继续DiT解码时准备Velox状态以备后期的块. 实施过程中使用了两重的新鲜度滞后. Chunk c c 通常通过块 c− 2 c-2 消耗几何,这已经足够了,因为frustum slab 逐渐重叠变化. 工人是几何物体的唯一作家. 主流只在需要未来状态时等待完成事件. 节次 C给出了完整的实施路径,包括工人溪流,VAE侧溪流,升温前,和尾部处理.

blocks.en: All speed numbers are measured on one H200 from the 48-chunk timing traces in Figure 3 . We report per-chunk attention-call latency and per-chunk denoising critical-path time rather than a single aggregate wall-clock number because early chunks have small dense-attention baseline cost, while late chunks expose the scaling behavior that matters for long video generation.
blocks.zh: 所有速度数都是用一个H200从图3中的48-cunk计时痕迹测量的。 我们报告每个圆柱的注意呼叫延迟和每圆柱的消音临界路径时间,而不是一个总的壁时数,因为早期块的密集度基线成本很小,而后块则暴露出对于长视频生成至关重要的缩放行为.

blocks.en: Appendix C Asynchronous Frustum Slab Construction
blocks.zh: 附录 C 同步 Frustum 板块建筑

blocks.en: The geometry pipeline would be expensive if it were inserted serially between generated chunks. In a synchronous implementation, chunk c c must be denoised, decoded, reconstructed into depth and pose state, inserted into the frustum slab table and multiwarp cache, aligned with the next target cameras, and scored before chunk c + 1 c+1 can denoise. The reconstruction and frustum slab preparation path is on the same order as one DiT denoise step in our setting, so serial execution would hide the attention-kernel gains.
blocks.zh: 如果在产生的块之间连续插入几何管道,则会很昂贵。 在同步执行中,c块必须解码,解码,重建为深度和姿势状态,插入frustum slab表和多瓦缓存,与下一个目标摄像头对齐,并在c块+1 c+1可以脱鼠之前得分. 重建 和 frustum 板块准备 路径的顺序 与我们设置中一个 DiT denoise 步骤的顺序相同, 因此序列处决会隐藏 注意力-内核收益。

blocks.en: Velox relaxes this dependency with a two-chunk freshness lag. Target chunk c c consumes a Velox state built from frustum slabs through chunk c − 2 c-2 , while the worker prepares states for later chunks. The state remains self-consistent: each worker task first inserts exactly one decoded chunk into the frustum slab table and multiwarp cache, then scores that table against the target chunk’s latent cameras. Chunks before the first available Velox state run dense attention, so the method never consumes an uninitialized route.
blocks.zh: 维洛克斯以两吨的新鲜度滞后来放松这种依赖. 目标区块c c 消耗通过区块c - 2 c - 2 所构建的 Velox 状态,而工人则为后期区块准备状态。 状态依然自成一体:每个工人任务首先在frustum slab表和多瓦缓存中插入一个完全解码的块,然后根据目标块的潜伏相机对表进行评分。 在第一个可用的Velox状态之前的春克斯运行着密集的注意力,因此该方法从未消耗一个未初始化的路径.

blocks.en: The implementation uses one Python worker thread and one dedicated CUDA stream. The worker is the sole writer to the frustum slab table, pose aligner, multiwarp frame cache, and sparse-attention context. The main denoising thread submits a geometry task after a chunk decode and receives a future keyed by the target chunk. Immediately before chunk c c denoises, the main stream waits on the future’s CUDA event if the worker has not already finished, then consumes the prepared geometric and importance states. This wait is a device-side stream dependency. There is no host-wide synchronization in the hot path.
blocks.zh: 实施过程中使用了一条Python工人线和一条专用的CUDA流. 工人是frustum slab表的唯一写手,摆出对齐器,多瓦框架缓存,以及稀疏上下文. 主解密线程在块解码后提交一个几何任务,并收到目标块所绑定的未来键. 如果工人还没有完成CUDA活动, 则主要溪流会紧接着进行, 此等待是设备侧流依赖 。 热路没有全主机同步.

blocks.en: Each geometry task performs four operations. First, the reconstructed frames are passed through the streaming reconstruction backend to update depths, poses, confidence, and masks. Second, the relative alignment maps target camera-control poses into the reconstructed frame and refreshes stored slab cameras under the current bridge. Third, valid depth samples are converted into per-block frustum slab primitives and inserted into the versioned frustum slab table, while first and last frame depths are cached for multiwarp. Fourth, the sparse context warps cached depths into the target cameras, builds Q frustum slabs, scores OBB overlap against historical frustum slabs, computes coverage, and materializes the geometric state consumed by soft fusion at each attention layer.
blocks.zh: 每一个几何任务都执行四个操作. 首先,重建框架通过流体重建后端,更新深度、姿势、信心和面具。 其次,相对对齐的地图目标相机控制器将存储在目前桥下重建的框架和刷新的板状相机. 第三,有效深度样本被转换成每个块的frustum slab原始体,并插入到版本的frustum slab表,而第一和最后一帧深度则被缓存为多瓦. 第四,稀疏的上下文warps缓存深度进入目标摄像头,建立Q frustum slabs,比历史的frustum slabs重分OBB,计算覆盖度,实现每个注意力层软聚变消耗的几何状态.

blocks.en: The implementation also moves VAE decode off the denoise critical path with a side stream, prewarms the worker thread’s cuDNN handle, prewarms segmentation and sparse-attention kernels outside the measured interval, and skips frustum slab scoring for the final chunk because no later denoise consumes it. Frames are moved to CPU after decode and copied back on the worker stream, avoiding extra GPU residency while the main stream denoises.
blocks.zh: 执行还将VAE用侧流解码到demoise关键路径,将工人线程的cuDNN手柄预加热,在测量间隔之外预加分解和缺心内核,并跳过frustum slab对最后块的评分,因为没有demoise以后会消耗它. 框架在解码后移动到CPU,并复制回工人流,避免在主流凹陷时额外的GPU居住权.

blocks.en: All reported timing results use a single NVIDIA H200. The async worker and the DiT denoiser share that one GPU. Memory reconstruction is not offloaded to a second device. A second GPU could reduce CUDA-stream contention and further improve end-to-end time, but it is not part of the reported measurement protocol.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的计时结果都使用单一的NVIDIA H200。 合成工人和DiT Denoiser分享一个GPU。 内存重建没有卸载到第二个设备中 。 第二个GPU可以减少CUDA-流的争议,进一步改善端到端的时间,但它不是所报告的测量协议的一部分.

blocks.zh: 附录 D Velox 注意核心和全球吉尔伯特布局

blocks.en: The sparse route is implemented as a native indexed attention path. The router produces block lists, the KV cache is stored in the order consumed by those lists, and the Triton kernel performs only the selected block interactions.

blocks.en: D.5 Failure Modes and Validation Scope
blocks.zh: D.5 失败模式和验证范围

blocks.en: Velox is most reliable when the frustum slab table and multiwarp Q-depth explain the current view. The expected failure cases are therefore geometry-driven. If reconstructed depth drifts, if the multiwarp cache fills a newly disoccluded token with stale far geometry, or if OBB approximation overestimates overlap for a thin structure, soft fusion can promote stale or misleading history. The current router mitigates these cases by applying geometry only to well-covered rows, bounding the geometric multiplier, retaining the layer-specific model distribution, and preserving previous-chunk and local-neighbor safeguards. The goal is to remove history that is spatially irrelevant while retaining enough model evidence for noisy generated-video geometry.
blocks.zh: Velox最可靠的是frustum slab table和multivewarp Q深度解释当前观点. 因此,预期的失败案例是几何驱动的。 如果重建的深度漂移,如果多瓦缓存用 Stale far 几何来填充新解开的符号,或者如果 OBB 近似值对细结构的重叠估计,软聚变可以促进 stale 或误导历史. 目前的路由器通过只对覆盖完好的行应用几何来减轻这些情况,将几何乘数限定,保留图层特异性模型分布,并保留先前的cunk和局部邻的保障措施. 目标是去除与空间无关的历史,同时保留足够的模型证据,用于噪音生成的视频几何.

blocks.en: The WBench evaluation also suggests where future quality regressions should be inspected. Velox improves spatial and photometric consistency over dense attention, but perspective and subject consistency decrease. This is consistent with the design risk: static background regions are usually supported by frustum slabs, while object- or camera-sensitive regions can be dynamic, partially reconstructed, or semantically important despite weak geometric correspondence. A stronger quality study should therefore report object-centric cases separately from background revisits and regions where Q-depth or frustum slab overlap assumptions are stressed.
blocks.zh: WBench评价也建议应检查未来的质量回归。 Velox比密集的注意力提高了空间和测光一致性,但视角和主题一致性下降. 这与设计风险是一致的:静态背景区域通常由frustum slabs支持,而物体或相机敏感区域尽管几何通信能力弱,但可以动态,部分重建,或具有聚合重要性. 因此,应当加强质量研究,报告以对象为中心的案例,与背景回顾和强调 " Q " 深度或 " frustum " 板块重叠假设的区域分开。

blocks.en: Finally, speed and quality should be validated under matched budgets. A random same-size route can test whether any sparsity helps. A recent-window route can test whether temporal locality is enough. A frame/FOV route can test whether view-level retrieval is sufficient. A model-derived route can test whether geometry adds value beyond attention statistics. Velox should outperform these baselines specifically when current regions have different relevant histories. This validation target is sharper than only comparing against dense attention, because it isolates the contribution of frustum slab geometry as the routing signal.
blocks.zh: 最后,应在相应的预算中验证速度和质量。 一个随机的相同大小的路由可以测试是否有任何痉挛帮助. 最近的窗口路线可以测试时间位置是否足够。 一个帧/FOV路由可以测试视图级检索是否足够. 模型衍生的路由可以检验几何是否在注意力统计之外增加了价值. 当目前的区域有不同的相关历史时,Velox应具体地超过这些基线。 这个验证目标比仅仅比较密集的注意更尖锐,因为它将frustum slab几何学的贡献隔离为路由信号.
